meta.title: Leo's Cartoon Strip
meta.textType: story: a cartoon in six pictures

paragraphs: On Monday, August third, Leo showed his new cartoon to Lily and Mia. They sat in Lily's living room after school. The cartoon had six pictures, and each picture had some words under it. The first three said, "Tom washes his bike," "Pip sees the water," and "Pip jumps!" The last three said, "Pip is wet," "Pip shakes," and "Now Tom is wet too!" Leo was excited, and he watched their faces. Mia looked at the first picture and smiled.

The story was from Sunday afternoon. It was a hot day, and the garden was quiet. Leo was visiting Lily's house. He sat on the step with his notebook. Tom was washing his bike in the garden with a hose. Pip was lying under a tree when he saw the water. He was a naughty, furry puppy, and he loved to play in water. Pip ran across the grass. Tom tried to catch him, but the puppy was very quick. Leo was drawing fast when Pip jumped at the water.

Pip stopped next to Tom. Then he shook his brown coat. The drops of water fell on Tom's shirt. Tom looked at his wet shirt. Tom was surprised, but then he laughed. Pip was still wet, and he wagged his tail. Leo laughed too. He nearly dropped his pencil. The red ball lay on the grass near Pip. "That is a good story for the Explorers' Blog," said Leo to himself.

Now Mia looked at each picture slowly. "I like Pip," she said. "He is a funny character." Leo asked, "Is the order clear?" "Yes, I can follow it," said Lily. "The action is quick, and the pictures are simple," said Mia. "What happened after the last picture?" asked Mia. "Tom gave him a towel, but Pip was still a little wet," said Leo. Tom came into the room when Mia was talking. He saw the cartoon on the sofa. He was amazed. "Is that me?" he asked. Pip heard his name and ran under the table to hide. Everyone laughed.
